description: The scene shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with no clearly marked or continuous sidewalk; the pedestrian space appears limited to a narrow edge/shoulder along the right side, with a rougher surface and no visible curb ramps or tactile paving. Traffic is separated from the building side by the roadway width and a low curb/edge, with trees lining both sides providing substantial shade, but there are few pedestrian amenities (no visible lighting, crossings, or street furniture) and minimal protection from vehicle movement.
